title: Fast before work
review_text: It finishes my usual cup quickly, and I like seeing the numbered settings.

title: Louder than expected
review_text: The motor is convenient but louder than I expected in a shared office kitchen.

title: Takes space in my bag
review_text: The body feels stable on a counter, but it is bulky and heavier than I want for carry-on travel.

title: Forgot to charge it
review_text: I reached the office with a low battery and could not finish the batch until I charged it.

title: Useful range
review_text: I use several settings, although I have not tested all 38.
